39483-farm-boys-and-girls.title: Farm Boys And Girls
39483-farm-boys-and-girls.creator: WILLIAM A. McKEEVER
39483-farm-boys-and-girls.description: A book by WILLIAM A. McKEEVER. In the preparation of this book I have had in mind two classes of readers; namely, the rural parents and the many persons who are interested in carrying forward the rural work discussed in the several chapters. It has been my aim to give as much specific aid and direction as possible. The first two chapters constitute a mere outline of some of the fundamental principles of child development.

arxiv-2008-06952.title: A Functional Perspective on Learning Symmetric Functions with Neural Networks
arxiv-2008-06952.creator: Aaron Zweig, Joan Bruna
arxiv-2008-06952.description: Abstract Symmetric functions, which take as input an unordered, fixed-size set, are known to be universally representable by neural networks that enforce permutation invariance. These architectures only give guarantees for fixed input sizes, yet in many practical applications, including point clouds and particle physics, a relevant notion of generalization should include varying the input size.

arxiv-2107-11257.title: Hamiltonian structure of the guiding-center Vlasov-Maxwell equations
arxiv-2107-11257.creator: Alain J. Brizard
arxiv-2107-11257.description: Abstract The Hamiltonian structure of the guiding-center Vlasov-Maxwell equations is presented in terms of a Hamiltonian functional and a guiding-center Vlasov-Maxwell bracket. The bracket, which is shown to satisfy the Jacobi identity exactly, is used to show that the guiding-center momentum and angular-momentum conservation laws can also be expressed in Hamiltonian form.

arxiv-2112-08671.title: Model-free Bootstrap Prediction Regions for Multivariate Time Series
arxiv-2112-08671.creator: Yiren Wang, Dimitris N. Politis
arxiv-2112-08671.description: Abstract In [ 3 ] , a model-free bootstrap(MFB) paradigm was proposed for generating prediction intervals of univariate, (locally) stationary time series. Theoretical guarantees for this algorithm was resolved in [ 11 ] under stationarity and weak dependence condition. Following this line of work, here we extend MFB for predictive inference under a multivariate time series setup.

arxiv-2310-10599.title: A multitor formula for a non-lci intersection
arxiv-2310-10599.creator: Oscar Finegan
arxiv-2310-10599.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Oscar Finegan. In this paper we produce the first known formula for cohomologies of the derived tensor products of structure sheaves of subschemes in the case where the intersection of the subschemes is not a local complete intersection. The case covered here is where the intersection instead consists of two local complete intersection components, one of codimension 1 and the other of arbitrary codimension.

arxiv-2410-00953.title: Monte Carlo Simulation of Operator Dynamics and Entanglement in Dual-Unitary Circuits
arxiv-2410-00953.creator: Menghan Song, Zhaoyi Zeng, Ting-Tung Wang, Yi-Zhuang You, Zi Yang Meng, Pengfei Zhang
arxiv-2410-00953.description: Abstract We investigate operator dynamics and entanglement growth in dual-unitary circuits, a class of locally scrambled quantum systems that enables efficient simulation beyond the exponential complexity of the Hilbert space. By mapping the operator evolution to a classical Markov process, we perform Monte Carlo simulations to access the time evolution of local operator density and entanglement with polynomial computational cost.

arxiv-2411-06187.title: BM-PAW: A Profitable Mining Attack in the PoW-based Blockchain System
arxiv-2411-06187.creator: Junjie Hu, Na Ruan ( ✉ ) {}^{(\textrm{{\char 0\relax}})}
arxiv-2411-06187.description: Abstract Mining attacks enable an adversary to procure a disproportionately large portion of mining rewards by deviating from honest mining practices within the PoW-based blockchain system. In this paper, we demonstrate that the security vulnerabilities of PoW-based blockchain extend beyond what these mining attacks initially reveal.

arxiv-2510-16850.title: DiRAC - Distributed Robot Awareness and Consensus
arxiv-2510-16850.creator: Kashish Mittal, Lakshasri S, Manjari Kulkarni, Uday Gopan, Sriram Radhakrishna, Aditya Naskar, Rameshwar DL
arxiv-2510-16850.description: Abstract DiRAC is a scalable, distributed framework designed to enable efficient task assignment and path planning in very large robotic swarms. It introduces a novel zone-partitioned architecture with dynamically elected leaders and a tick-synchronized consensus protocol that yields strong consistency and deterministic outcomes. For path planning, DiRAC uses a novel algorithm, a force-based decentralized planner for real-time collision resolution.

arxiv-2512-11116.title: Characterization of CRYO ASIC for charge readout in the nEXO experiment
arxiv-2512-11116.creator: J. Zhao
arxiv-2512-11116.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by J. Zhao. nEXO is a proposed next-generation experiment searching for the neutrinoless double beta decay of 136 Xe using a tonne-scale liquid xenon (LXe) time projection chamber (TPC). To image the ionization signals from events in the liquid xenon, the detector will employ metallized fused-silica charge collection tiles instrumented with cryogenic application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), referred to as CRYO ASIC, which are designed to operate directly in LXe to minimize input capacitance and pick-up noise.

britannica-1911-jehoiakim.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-jehoiakim.description: Article 'Jehoiakim' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 15), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. son of y Josiah (q.v.) and king of Judah (2 Kings xxiii. On the defeat of Josiah at Megiddo his younger brother Jehoahaz (or Shallum) was chosen by the Judaeans, but the Egyptian conquerer Necho summoned him to his headquarters at Riblah (south of Hamath on the Orontes) and removed him to Egypt, appointing in his stead Eliakim, whose name (“El [God] raiseth up”) was changed to its better-known synonym, Jehoiakim.

europmc-pmc9969881.title: The clinical value of neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), platelet-to-lymphocyte ratio (PLR) and systemic inflammation response index (SIRI) for predicting the occurrence and severity of pneumonia in patients with intracerebral hemorrhage.

The neutrophil-to-lymphocyte ratio (NLR), systemic immune-inflammation index (SII), platelet-to-lymphocyte rati

francis-little-flowers-1910.description: The beloved collection of stories about St. Francis and his followers — the classic of Franciscan spirituality and medieval popular piety.

pmc-11423729.title: Perceptions of genomic newborn screening: a cross-sectional survey conducted with UK medical students
pmc-11423729.creator: Lydia Seed, Anna Scott, Amanda Pichini, Michelle Peter, Shereen Tadros, Cristine Sortica da Costa, Melissa Hill
pmc-11423729.description: BackgroundWith the potential to identify a vast number of rare diseases soon after birth, genomic newborn screening (gNBS) could facilitate earlier interventions and improve health outcomes. Designing a gNBS programme will involve balancing stakeholders’ opinions and addressing concerns. The views of medical students—future clinicians who would deliver gNBS—have not yet been explored.

pmc-11449844.title: Endangered Galápagos sea lions and fur seals under the siege of lethal avian flu: a cautionary note on emerging infectious viruses in endemic pinnipeds of the Galápagos Islands

pmc-11486056.title: “A safe, non-judgmental space where I can really challenge myself:” learner experiences in a virtual, case-based diagnostic reasoning conference for students
pmc-11486056.creator: John C Penner, María J Alemán, Andrea Anampa-Guzmán, Aaron L Berkowitz, Saman Nematollahi
pmc-11486056.description: Case-based diagnostic reasoning conferences, like morning reports, allow undergraduate medical trainees to practice diagnostic reasoning alongside senior clinicians. However, trainees have reported discomfort doing so. Peer-assisted learning offers an alternative approach. We describe the design, implementation, and evaluation of a virtual, student-only diagnostic reasoning conference that leverages peer-assisted learning.

pmc-11495926.title: Diagnostic performance of Leishmania braziliensis and Leishmania peruviana antigens in the immunoblot method for the detection of american tegumentary leishmaniasis
pmc-11495926.creator: Nyshon Rojas-Palomino, Aidé Sandoval-Juarez, Gilmer Solis-Sánchez, Gloria Minaya-Gómez, Nyshon Rojas-Palomino, Aidé Sandoval-Juarez, Gilmer Solis-Sánchez, Gloria Minaya-Gómez
pmc-11495926.description: This study aimed to determine the performance of Leishmania braziliensis and Leishmania peruviana antigens in the detection of ATL by using serum samples obtained between 2013 - 2016. The obtained soluble and excretion/secretion antigens were transferred to membrane nitrocellulose by immunoblot assay.

pmc-11514359.title: Neuralgic amyotrophy with hourglass-like constrictions: A case report
pmc-11514359.creator: Mi-Hyeon Bang, Ha-Lim Song, Seok Hahn, Wanil Kim, Hwan-Kwon Do
pmc-11514359.description: BACKGROUNDNeuralgic amyotrophy (NA) is a rare disease with sudden upper limb pain followed by affected muscle weakness. The most commonly affected area in NA is the upper part of the brachial plexus, and the paraspinal muscles are rarely affected (1.5%), making these cases difficult to distinguish from cervical radiculopathy.

pmc-11656859.title: Self-assessment and learning motivation in emergency point-of-care ultrasound: an online pilot investigation in German physicians
pmc-11656859.creator: Joachim Bansbach, Michael Bentele, Matthias Bollinger, Stefanie Bentele, Ronny Langenhan, Bianka Gerber, Milena Trifunovic-Koenig, Stefan Bushuven
pmc-11656859.description: IntroductionLearning motivation is essential to obtain and maintain ultrasound competencies in emergency medicine. One’s competencies herein and the need for ongoing training are best evaluated by self-assessment. This may be flawed by overconfidence effects - the belief to be better than others or better than tests reveal.

pmc-12439480.title: Dimeric CCK2R radiotheranostic tracers synergize with mTOR inhibition for enhanced tumor therapy
pmc-12439480.creator: Linjie Bian, Zheyi Wang, Panli Li, Simin He, Jianping Zhang, Xiaoping Xu, Xiangwei Wang, Shaoli Song
pmc-12439480.description: Purpose: The cholecystokinin-2 receptor (CCK2R) is highly expressed in several neuroendocrine cancers, particularly in medullary thyroid carcinoma (MTC) and small cell lung cancer (SCLC) and represents a promising target for radiotheranostic applications. Several minigastrin-derived analogs, such as DOTA-MGS5 and DOTA-CCK-66, have demonstrated favorable tumor targeting and imaging performance.

pmc-12587705.title: Spontaneous passage of an accidentally ingested metallic bullet casing in an adolescent: a case report
pmc-12587705.creator: Sowdo Nur Iyow, Abdullahi Ahmed Ahmed, Abdulkadir Nur Mohamed, Shuayb Moallim Ali Jama, Hassan Adan Ali Adan
pmc-12587705.description: BackgroundAccidental ingestion of foreign objects is a frequent emergency presentation that can lead to serious complications. It is most often seen in children and high-risk adults, but remains rare in healthy adolescents without predisposing factors.Case presentationWe describe a 17-year-old female who accidentally swallowed a metallic bullet casing during a meal.

pmc-12597300.title: Iron-doped Zif-8 nanoplatform for MRI-guided synergistic microwave thermal/chemodynamic therapy of triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-12597300.creator: Zhenyu Xiang, Jialing Liu, Yan Zhang, Ru Shen, Ying Lu, Rong Li, Qinying Shi, Guannan Zhang, Sijin Li, Jianbo Song
pmc-12597300.description: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), a highly refractory malignancy characterized by aggressive clinical behavior, poses a significant therapeutic challenge due to its resistance to conventional treatments. While microwave thermal therapy (MWTT) emerges as a promising modality for TNBC treatment through deep-tissue penetration and uniform energy delivery, its reliance on prolonged hyperthermia exposure risks collateral damage to adjacent healthy tissues.

pmc-12727716.title: Microbial metabolism amplified warming in three Phanerozoic hyperthermal events
pmc-12727716.creator: Yuyang Wu, Haijun Song, Daoliang Chu, Ying Cui, Jacopo Dal Corso, Genming Luo, Huyue Song, Li Tian, Hanchen Song, Enhao Jia, Jinnan Tong
pmc-12727716.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The ocean’s biological carbon pump (BCP) plays a crucial role in climate regulation by facilitating long-term removal of atmospheric CO2. However, BCP changes during past hyperthermals remain poorly understood. Here we use the vertical carbon isotope (δ13C) gradients between surface and mid-waters to trace the BCP changes during the Permian−Triassic, early Toarcian, and Palaeocene−Eocene hyperthermals, detecting a two- to three-fold increase in the vertical δ13C gradients.

pmc-13115264.title: Evolutionary Characteristics and Expression Patterns of the UGT Gene Family in Epimedium from Gansu, China
pmc-13115264.creator: Luna Xing, Jun Zhao, Qianwen Song, Chunlei Zheng, Qingyan Zhao, Wei Chen, Xiaowei Zhang, Xuhu Wang, Weibo Du, Songsong Lu, Xiaolei Zhou
pmc-13115264.description: Epimedium brevicornu is an important medicinal plant in China, whose main bioactive components are flavonoid glycosides. UDP-glycosyltransferases (UGTs) play key roles in flavonoid glycosylation and metabolic diversification. In this study, transcriptome data from four representative production regions in Gansu Province were used to systematically identify and analyze the UGT gene family in E. brevicornu.

pmc-13271146.title: Cost-Effectiveness of Blinatumomab Plus Chemotherapy vs Chemotherapy in Adults Newly Diagnosed with Philadelphia-Negative B-Cell Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia in Italy
pmc-13271146.creator: Gianni Ghetti, Luca Castello, Linet Awino Odonde, Serena De Fazio, Andrea Stella, Angela Bruno, Emanuele Marchionne, Massimiliano Bonifacio
pmc-13271146.description: BackgroundWhile chemotherapy is the standard treatment for adults with newly diagnosed Philadelphia chromosome-negative (Ph-) B-cell precursor acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL), long-term remission remains difficult to achieve. Blinatumomab, an immunotherapy drug, has shown survival benefits when alternated with consolidation chemotherapy in patients with CD19-positive Ph- B-cell ALL, but its economic value had not been assessed in Italy.

pmc-13314456.title: TLR7/8 agonist 3M-052 formulated in micelles induces local type I IFN response and antiviral immunity in zebrafish larvae
pmc-13314456.creator: Dean Porter, Hannah Wiggett, Axel Benchetrit, Pierre Boudinot, Bernard Verrier, Didier Gigmes, Thomas Trimaille, Jean-Pierre Levraud

pmc-13350070.title: Imaging the interaction of astrocytes and neurons
pmc-13350070.creator: Karl Herholz
pmc-13350070.description: Molecular imaging of the interaction between astrocytes and neurons in humans is an important yet challenging task. While previous studies indicated that activation of astrocytes may contribute to the loss of neurons, the paper by Crine et al. in this issue found the opposite, a corresponding decline of imaging markers for astrocytes and dopaminergic neurons.

pmc-13416918.title: Case Report: Influenza B-triggered CIDP revealing PMP22-related Dejerine–Sottas-like neuropathy in a child—biphasic cytokine dynamics and response to immunotherapy
pmc-13416918.creator: Yazhen Fan, Junying Qiao, Jingpo Zhang, Jianchuang Zhao, Xianjie Huang, Chenhang Cui, Na Wang
pmc-13416918.description: Dejerine–Sottas disease (DSD) is a severe early-onset hereditary demyelinating neuropathy, but its overlap with chronic inflammatory demyelinating polyradiculoneuropathy (CIDP) has rarely been described in children. We report a child in whom influenza B-triggered CIDP led to the recognition of a previously undiagnosed PMP22-related hereditary demyelinating neuropathy with a severe Dejerine–Sottas-like phenotype.

pmc-13529025.title: Exact non-static cylindrical solutions of Einstein’s field equations with imperfect fluids
pmc-13529025.creator: Tahir Hussain, Muhammad Farhan, Hala Mostafa, Sk. A. Shezan, Nowshad Amin, Rayan Hamza Alsisi, Naveed Ahmad
pmc-13529025.description: This work systematically derives a broad class of exact cylindrically symmetric spacetime models possessing scaling symmetries of varying dimensions. These models are then used to solve Einstein’s field equations for an imperfect fluid source that yields explicit anisotropic energy-momentum distributions.

pmc-13681901.title: Causal relationship between cardiac arrhythmias and sepsis: a two-sample bidirectional mendelian randomization study
pmc-13681901.creator: Xinglei Li, Yadong Yang, Xunqi Zhang, Tianyi Lu, Lingling Liu, Zhengjun Kong, Tao Cui
pmc-13681901.description: ObjectiveThis study used a bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) framework to investigate whether genetic liability to cardiac arrhythmias increases the risk of sepsis and whether genetic liability to sepsis increases the risk of cardiac arrhythmias.MethodsSummary statistics were obtained from publicly available genome-wide association studies in individuals of European ancestry.
